findings.body: The compiled ERB produces `end if` (an `end` that closes the if-block immediately followed by a bare `if` keyword), which is a Ruby SyntaxError, so rendering the embed view raises and the endpoint returns a 500 instead of the discussion highlights.
findings.failure_mode: View template fails to compile/execute, raising a syntax error at render time.
findings.impact: The compiled ERB produces `end if` (an `end` that closes the if-block immediately followed by a bare `if` keyword), which is a Ruby SyntaxError, so rendering the embed view raises and the endpoint returns a 500 instead of the discussion highlights.
findings.root_cause: The added closing tag emits `end if` instead of `end`, appending a stray `if` keyword after the block terminator.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the closing tag to `<%- end %>` to properly terminate the `if/else` block.
findings.title: Invalid Ruby in ERB: `<%- end if %>` closes the block then leaves a dangling `if`
findings.trigger: Any request that reaches EmbedController#best with a resolved topic_id so that the `best` template is rendered.
findings.verifier_reason: Line 6 of app/views/embed/best.html.erb shows `<%- end if %>` verbatim in the patch. ERB compiles this to Ruby code containing `end if` which is invalid syntax - `end` closes the if-block, then a bare `if` keyword follows with no condition. This will raise SyntaxError when the template is rendered.

raw_findings.body: Because `execute` short-circuits on the first `feed_polling_enabled?` clause (default false), `poll_feed` is never invoked regardless of feed_polling_url, so the assertion `expects(:poll_feed).never` passes even if the feed_polling_url guard were removed; the test does not actually verify the feed_polling_url requirement.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Test provides false confidence and would not catch regressions in the feed_polling_url guard.
raw_findings.impact: Because `execute` short-circuits on the first `feed_polling_enabled?` clause (default false), `poll_feed` is never invoked regardless of feed_polling_url, so the assertion `expects(:poll_feed).never` passes even if the feed_polling_url guard were removed; the test does not actually verify the feed_polling_url requirement.
raw_findings.root_cause: The test omits stubbing the earlier guard conditions, letting the first `&&` clause satisfy the assertion trivially.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Stub `feed_polling_enabled?` to true and `embed_by_username` to a present value in this test so only feed_polling_url is nil, ensuring the guard under test is exercised.
raw_findings.title: poll_feed_spec 'requires feed_polling_url' passes for the wrong reason
raw_findings.trigger: Test run with default SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled? == false (the shipped default) and only feed_polling_url stubbed to nil.
